decision_status_reason: The client's request to reuse an existing NIR calibration with a new API and excipient blend is unlikely to succeed without re-calibration due to matrix changes. Adding Raman does not preserve the old calibration; it requires its own calibration and validation.

stated: Existing NIR pilot follows API concentration in one powder formulation at the tablet press feed frame.
A different API and excipient blend is being introduced.
There is a desire to reuse the existing NIR calibration.

steps: Conduct NIR measurements on the new blend using the existing calibration.
Develop and validate a new Raman calibration for the new blend.
Compare the results to assess compatibility and complementarity.

premise_findings.finding: A chemometric calibration is built and validated for a specific sample matrix. A changed composition is a new matrix, so the existing model must be re-tested and most likely rebuilt. Adding a second method creates a new (fused) model that also needs calibration and validation; it does not keep the old model valid.
